newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge down in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge down in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged down in early morning trade on Thursday as market participants took profits after sharp gains in recent sessions, brokers said.
They said, however, that market sentiment remained relatively strong.
The 225-share Nikkei average fell 73.87 points or 0.40 percent to 18,261.43, after surging 538.73 points on Wednesday. Its March futures lost 70 points to 18,300.

"Domestic institutional investors and dealers were inclined to take profits as the Nikkei average gained about 1,000 points in the last two sessions," said a broker at one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages.
Another broker said that institutional investors are unlikely to actively take profits until the Nikkei rises to around the 19,000 point level.
